usgs-sgmc.title: The State Geologic Map Compilation (SGMC) geodatabase of the conterminous United States
usgs-sgmc.citation: Horton, J.D., San Juan, C.A., and Stoeser, D.B., 2017, The State Geologic Map Compilation (SGMC) geodatabase of the conterminous United States (ver. 1.1, August 2017): U.S. Geological Survey Data Series 1052, https://doi.org/10.3133/ds1052.
usgs-sgmc.notes: The first service is the official copy published by USGS ScienceBase for the data release. The second is an ArcGIS Online copy (publisher unverified), used only if the first fails. The 2026 GeMS update (https://doi.org/10.5066/P1A3DQZK) revised other states, not South Carolina.

census-tiger-roads.title: US Census Bureau TIGER/Line roads via TIGERweb Transportation: Primary Roads (layer 2), Secondary Roads (layer 6) and Local Roads (layer 8)
census-tiger-roads.license: Public domain (U.S. Government work). Shown live with attribution ("Roads: US Census Bureau TIGER/Line (live)") and not copied.
census-tiger-roads.notes: Read live by the viewer (web/roads.js) for the area on screen. Fields: NAME (full name, e.g. 'I- 26', 'US Hwy 17', 'State Hwy 61'), RTTYP (I, U, S, C, M), MTFCC (S1100 primary, S1200 secondary, S1400 local, S1630 ramp) and OID (TIGER LINEARID, cited in the callout). Queries use an envelope, outFields, f=geojson, resultOffset/resultRecordCount and maxAllowableOffset; CORS echoes the requesting origin. Layer numbers can change with each TIGERweb vintage.

county-parcels.title: County parcel services (property lines and tax map parcel IDs)
county-parcels.license: Each county's own terms; parcels are queried live and never copied (several counties restrict redistribution).

ngs-vertcon.title: VERTCON: NGVD 29 to NAVD 88 vertical datum transformation grid (eastern United States)
ngs-vertcon.citation: National Geodetic Survey, NOAA, VERTCON version 2.1; distributed as us_noaa_vertcone.tif in PROJ-data
ngs-vertcon.use: Downloaded once by harvest/vertcon.py into .cache/grids/; shifts NGVD29 elevations to NAVD88 (model/vdatum.py)
